design: locals: a CALL/CALLIND output is a base under every parameter condition (is_call_return); all = locals + nest
a callee whose declared (locked) return points at something other than void/unknown declines

copies_alone: the value and its COPY/CAST closure must reach no MULTIEQUAL/INDIRECT and must not sit in address-tied storage; storage_is_tied also declines a value overlapping (by bytes) what any live RETURN reads where a phi writes that return register (mark_output_storage_addr_tied ties it later; kmod O2 0x7ee0 kept a name, its length and a calloc record in one rax of an int function)
returned_beside_others: a record returned on one path while another RETURN returns a different non-zero value declines (one return type; dash O2 0x12750, either())

stored_text/bytes_text: a base whose every access stores text -- constant bytes, or up to 16 bytes loaded from a read-only literal, INDIRECT-clobbered or not -- is a string buffer (tar SCHILY.xattr., cp O2 0xbe10 CuXXXXXX)

points_past: a base declines when a copy forms an address at or past the end of every access (sortlines &node->lock, mountlist &me->me_next, kmod name[], grep &buf[2]): the record is wider than the function shows

under locals a function asks its widest layout first, so its own later layout never supersedes an earlier answer: without it a --jobs 8 run on tar O2 fell back to one ordered worker (15.2 s -> 26.0 s)
